standard-dialogue-before-lost-city.player: Why are you guys hanging around here?
Uh... yeah, sorry about that. Why are you all standing around out here?

standard-dialogue-before-lost-city.npc: Well, that's really none of your business.

standard-dialogue-after-learning-how-to-.player: So you didn't find the entrance to Zanaris yet, huh?

standard-dialogue-after-learning-how-to-.npc: Don't tell me a novice like YOU has found it!

standard-dialogue-after-learning-how-to-.player: Yep. Found it REALLY easily too.

standard-dialogue-after-learning-how-to-.npc: ...I cannot believe that someone like YOU could find the portal where experienced adventurers such as ourselves could not.

standard-dialogue-after-learning-how-to-.player: Believe what you want. Enjoy your little camp fire.
